servers.description: Edge Delivery Services (EDS) Admin API client — CLI and MCP server.

tools.name: eds_get_status
tools.description: Use this when you need one path's current status across edit/preview/live/code/index on a single site — the smallest, cheapest status call.

tools.name: eds_get_status_bulk
tools.description: Use this when you need status for several paths on a site at once instead of calling eds_get_status in a loop.

tools.name: eds_set_live_state
tools.description: Use this to publish or unpublish one or more paths on a site. Destructive: it changes what is publicly live.

tools.name: eds_get_site_config
tools.description: Use this when you need a site's full effective configuration — the site document alone does not resolve inheritance.

tools.name: eds_reindex
tools.description: Use this to re-run indexing for specific paths, or — only with explicit double confirmation — the entire site.

tools.name: eds_get_audit_log
tools.description: Use this to review recent changes to a site. Returns one page of entries plus a nextToken cursor.

tools.name: eds_get_snapshots
tools.description: Use this to list a site's snapshots, or to inspect one by id.

tools.name: eds_manage_snapshot
tools.description: Use this to add paths to a snapshot, remove them, publish it, submit a review decision, or delete it.

tools.name: eds_get_job_status
tools.description: Use this to check on a specific job by its site/ref/topic/name address, e.g. one returned earlier by eds_set_live_state or eds_reindex.

servers.description: Adobe Commerce Optimizer (ACO) admin and Merchandising API client — CLI and MCP server.

tools.name: aco_search_catalog
tools.description: Use this to search a catalog view's products by phrase and page through results, with facet buckets included. No credential is required for an unprotected view.

tools.name: aco_get_facet_values
tools.description: Use this to check whether an attribute is facetable for a catalog view and list its available values with counts. No credential is required for an unprotected view.

tools.name: aco_list_catalog_views
tools.description: Use this to discover the catalog views (viewId, locales, default price book, policies) available in this tenant. Requires an ACO admin credential.

tools.name: aco_list_price_books
tools.description: Use this to list price books, optionally filtered by searchTerm, and to page through more with the returned scrollId. Requires an ACO admin credential.

tools.name: aco_list_policies
tools.description: Use this to list every policy configured in this tenant with its actions and filters, before deciding which filter to enable or disable. Requires an ACO admin credential.

tools.name: aco_toggle_policy_filter
tools.description: Use this to enable or disable one filter inside one named policy, addressed by the attribute it carries. There is no policy-level enable/disable in this API and no "apply to all" mode. Requires an ACO admin credential.

servers.description: Magento Cloud CLI wrapper — CLI and MCP server for read-only Magento Cloud project, environment, and database operations.

tools.name: magentocloud_auth_status
tools.description: Use this to check whether the Magento Cloud CLI is authenticated before calling any other magentocloud_* tool. Never requires a credential itself.

tools.name: magentocloud_list_projects
tools.description: Use this to list every project accessible to the authenticated account — the starting point for finding a projectId.

tools.name: magentocloud_describe_project
tools.description: Use this to get one project's title and region by projectId, before listing its environments.

tools.name: magentocloud_list_environments
tools.description: Use this to list a project's environments (id, status, type, title) — most other tools need an environmentId as input.

tools.name: magentocloud_describe_environment
tools.description: Use this to get one environment's status and type by projectId/environmentId.

tools.name: magentocloud_get_environment_config
tools.description: Use this to fetch environment configuration facets on demand: variables, routes, services, serviceEndpoints (credentials never returned), appConfig, and urls.

tools.name: magentocloud_get_activities
tools.description: Use this to list recent deployment/activity events for a project, narrowed by limit, type, state or result — or to fetch one activity by activityId. Each event carries its machine-readable type and timings, never the human-readable description.

tools.name: magentocloud_get_activity_log
tools.description: Use this to read one activity's full deployment/build log by activityId, as plain text.

tools.name: magentocloud_query_database
tools.description: Use this for a bounded, read-only diagnostic query against an environment's database — a size check, or a single guarded SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN statement.
